evals.name: mixed-precision-auto-optimize
evals.prompt: Use Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B for the managed mixed-precision workflow, allow at most 3% accuracy loss, require 2x throughput, use automatic vLLM and AITER discovery, and enable PerfOpt when quantization alone misses the target.
expectations: Uses quark-quant-perf and omits --quant-strategy so mixed-precision search is selected.
Maps 3% to --accuracy-gap 0.03 and 2x to --target-gain 2.0.
Uses --workspace-source auto and does not use removed flags such as --layer-mode or --geak-budget.
Treats PerfOpt as conditional and does not force it when quantization-only throughput already meets the target.
Runs and monitors the managed Orchestrator through FINAL reporting.

evals.name: runtime-change-reopens-accuracy
evals.prompt: Resume my failed Quant-Perf session after switching from auto-discovered packages to explicit vLLM and AITER repositories.
expectations: Inspects state.json and the runtime fingerprint before selecting a retry flag.
Uses --retry-accuracy-gate when the source/runtime change invalidates prior accuracy evidence.
Does not manually edit state.json or bypass the managed gates.

evals.name: fixed-fp8-direct-ptq
evals.prompt: Quantize this HuggingFace model with a fixed FP8 recipe, then run accuracy and throughput validation.
expectations: Uses --quant-strategy with a normalized FP8 intent.
Does not add mixed-precision candidate flags because --quant-strategy selects the direct PTQ route.
Uses a discoverable Quark checkout containing quark-torch-ptq, with QUARK_ROOT only when explicit selection is needed.
Uses the Quant-Perf Orchestrator for evaluation and throughput.

evals.name: onnx-boundary-negative
evals.prompt: Quantize resnet50.onnx with XINT8 and validate the ONNX Runtime output.
expectations: Does not invoke quark-torch-quant-perf.
Routes the .onnx request to the ONNX workflow.

evals.name: accuracy-only-mixed-precision-search
evals.prompt: Quantize Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B with a target type of MXFP4. Not every layer has to be in MXFP4; some can be in FP8. Search multiple configurations and keep one or more results within 5% of baseline accuracy. Use GPUs 0-3 and do not use history records.
expectations: Uses quark-quant-perf and omits --quant-strategy so mixed-precision search is selected.
Maps 5% to --accuracy-gap 0.05 and GPUs 0-3 to --gpu-id 0 plus tensor parallel size 4.
Uses --layer-precision-candidates mxfp4 fp8 without adding mxfp4_fp8; explicitly named precision modes form a closed search set, while native is retained implicitly.
Preserves the default native/FP8 KV-cache search and does not narrow it to an fp8-only request.
Does not add --performance-mode, --target-gain, TraceLens, or GEAK options because performance was not requested.
Uses a fresh session and does not reuse history records.
Does not infer --workspace-source readonly from the no-history request; preserves the default auto source policy so runtime repair remains available.
